zip_readme: The supplied README states that waist pitch/roll and ankle roll parallel-joint speed/torque values are serial-equivalent for training.

official_runtime_config.interpretation: These are official A3 T2D5 SIL/MOTION runtime configuration values. They are not per-unit encoder zero, torque constant, friction, or IMU calibration.

comparison.note: MJCF motor elements are present, but explicit controller gains are not encoded in this file.

motor_families.placement: upper J1-J2, waist roll/pitch, lower J5-J6

parallel_equivalent_estimates.verification_note: Screenshot label appears as ankle_roll under waist section; verify whether this means waist_roll.

rules: These values are approximate notes from screenshots, not measured robot calibration.
The supplied URDF README says waist and ankle parallel-joint limits, speed, and torque are already serial-equivalent for training.
Do not apply the gear ratio or parallel-joint equivalent factor a second time.
